scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start --prefix frontend" "npm run start --prefix backend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix backend
scripts.fix: npm run format && npm run lint-fix
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --prefix frontend && npm run type-check --prefix backend
scripts.clean: npm run clean --prefix frontend && npm run clean --prefix backend
scripts.clean-install: npm run clean && rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && npm install && npm run clean-install --prefix frontend && npm run clean-install --prefix backend
